title: Text Wrapping and Decoration
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of text wrapping and decoration and when it is appropriate.
Apply text wrapping using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check text truncation and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study text wrapping and decoration and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.

common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.
